facts.text: Jon is looking for a dance studio space with a good dance floor that provides enough bounce for dancing safely.

evidence.quote: We need a good dance floor with enough bounce for me & my students to dance safely.
Dance floors help avoid injuries and make dancing more enjoyable.

facts.text: Jon is considering Marley flooring for the dance studio because it is grippy, allows movement, and is durable and easy to clean.

evidence.quote: I'm after Marley flooring, which is what dance studios usually use. It's great 'cause it's grippy but still lets you move, plus it's tough and easy to keep clean.
Marley's perfect; it's got the right amount of grip and movement.

facts.text: Jon has been looking at different places for the dance studio and has found a location with great natural light.

evidence.quote: I've been looking at different places and picturing how the space would look. I even found a place with great natural light!
It's downtown which is awesome cuz it's easy to get to. Plus the natural light!

facts.text: Jon has been to Paris, and there is an image of a bathroom with a blue floor and a pink wall.

evidence.quote: I've been to Paris yesterday! It was sooo cool. [image: a photo of a bathroom with a blue floor and a pink wall]
